controls.label: Observed terrain
controls.description: Only terrain visible and illuminated during the 2004 Stardust encounter is included, about half the nucleus. The unseen side and gaps remain open. Neutral gray is a model material, not observed albedo. Source plate ordering is made consistent without moving vertices. The archived model axes are retained at an arbitrary fixed phase; no current rotational orientation or spin is claimed.
